svg.text: Computer Science at the University of Waterloo
I'm a backend-focused Computer Science student at the University of
Waterloo (AI specialization, Combinatorics & Optimization minor, class of
2028). I work on AI operations, cryptographic infrastructure and
distributed systems, and I usually end up teaching a program to play a
A TD(λ) CNN agent with expectimax search that reaches the 8192 tile in 52%
An autopilot for 9-category fantasy basketball: ML projections, Claude's
reading of the news and 2,000-run matchup simulations.
A multi-provider AI agent in a browser side panel for YouTube, Reddit,
A chat UI with side questions, conversation forking and rewind.
A text-based dungeon crawler in C++, built around object-oriented design.
